Bachelor of Business.admission_requirements: Domestic admission is by ATAR (minimum 70) or an equivalent Minimum Selection Rank of 70 in WA/ACT/NSW/NT/SA/TAS/VIC, with a scaled mark of 50 or higher in English ATAR, Literature ATAR or English as an Additional Dialect (EALD) ATAR, or a STAT Written English score of 140 or higher. Alternative pathways include Murdoch's own enabling programs (FlexiTrack, TLC Learning for Tomorrow), an enabling or bridging program at another Australian university, at least 2 years of TAFE or RTO study, GCE A Levels (aggregate of 6 points, including a D grade in English Language, English Literature or Knowledge and Inquiry), the International Baccalaureate Diploma (total score 24 or higher), or completion of 2 units at an Australian university or Open Universities Australia. International applicants are assessed against Murdoch's country specific secondary and tertiary qualification equivalencies.
Bachelor of Business.english_requirements: Standard Murdoch undergraduate English requirement: Academic IELTS overall 6.0 with no band below 6.0, or PTE Academic 50 overall (Reading 53, Writing 54, Speaking 50, Listening 50), or equivalent (TOEFL iBT 60, Duolingo English Test 115, Cambridge Advanced English 169, Occupational English Test grade C in every skill).

Bachelor of Information Technology.curriculum: Year 1: programming fundamentals, computer systems and networks, database fundamentals, introduction to information security. Year 2: network security, systems administration, software security principles, choice of major (Artificial Intelligence and Autonomous Systems, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Cyber Security and Forensics, Games Design and Development, Games Technology, Internetworking and Network Security, or Mobile and Web Application Development). Year 3: advanced major units (for example computer forensics and penetration testing in the Cyber Security and Forensics major), industry placement or capstone project. Total: 3 years full-time. The Artificial Intelligence and Autonomous Systems, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Cyber Security and Forensics, Games Technology, Internetworking and Network Security, and Mobile and Web Application Development majors are accredited at the Professional level by the Australian Computer Society (ACS).
Bachelor of Information Technology.admission_requirements: Domestic admission is by ATAR (minimum 70) or an equivalent Minimum Selection Rank of 70 in WA/ACT/NSW/NT/SA/TAS/VIC, with a scaled mark of 50 or higher in English ATAR, Literature ATAR or English as an Additional Dialect (EALD) ATAR, or a STAT Written English score of 140 or higher. Alternative pathways include Murdoch's own enabling programs (FlexiTrack, TLC Learning for Tomorrow), an enabling or bridging program at another Australian university, at least 2 years of TAFE or RTO study, GCE A Levels, the International Baccalaureate Diploma (total score 24 or higher), or completion of 2 units at an Australian university or Open Universities Australia. International applicants are assessed against Murdoch's country specific secondary and tertiary qualification equivalencies.
Bachelor of Information Technology.english_requirements: Standard Murdoch undergraduate English requirement: Academic IELTS overall 6.0 with no band below 6.0, or PTE Academic 50 overall (Reading 53, Writing 54, Speaking 50, Listening 50), or equivalent (TOEFL iBT 60, Duolingo English Test 115, Cambridge Advanced English 169, Occupational English Test grade C in every skill).

Bachelor of Laws.admission_requirements: Domestic admission is by ATAR (minimum 90) or an equivalent Minimum Selection Rank of 90 in WA/ACT/NSW/NT/SA/TAS/VIC, with a scaled mark of 50 or higher in English ATAR, Literature ATAR or English as an Additional Dialect (EALD) ATAR, or a STAT Written English score of 140 or higher. Alternative pathways include Murdoch's own enabling programs, an enabling or bridging program at another Australian university, at least 2 years of TAFE or RTO study, GCE A Levels, the International Baccalaureate Diploma, or completion of 2 units at an Australian university or Open Universities Australia. International applicants are assessed against Murdoch's country specific secondary and tertiary qualification equivalencies.
Bachelor of Laws.english_requirements: Murdoch's Bachelor of Laws carries a higher English requirement than the standard undergraduate tier: Academic IELTS overall 6.5 with no band below 6.0, or PTE Academic 58 overall (Reading 53, Writing 58, Speaking 50, Listening 50), or equivalent (TOEFL iBT 79, Duolingo English Test 120, Cambridge Advanced English 176, Occupational English Test 1 B and 3 Cs).

Bachelor of Psychology.admission_requirements: Domestic admission is by ATAR (minimum 70) or an equivalent Minimum Selection Rank of 70 in WA/ACT/NSW/NT/SA/TAS/VIC, with a scaled mark of 50 or higher in English ATAR, Literature ATAR or English as an Additional Dialect (EALD) ATAR, or a STAT Written English score of 140 or higher. Alternative pathways include Murdoch's own enabling programs, an enabling or bridging program at another Australian university, at least 2 years of TAFE or RTO study, GCE A Levels, the International Baccalaureate Diploma, or completion of 2 units at an Australian university or Open Universities Australia. International applicants are assessed against Murdoch's country specific secondary and tertiary qualification equivalencies.
Bachelor of Psychology.english_requirements: Standard Murdoch undergraduate English requirement: Academic IELTS overall 6.0 with no band below 6.0, or PTE Academic 50 overall (Reading 53, Writing 54, Speaking 50, Listening 50), or equivalent (TOEFL iBT 60, Duolingo English Test 115, Cambridge Advanced English 169, Occupational English Test grade C in every skill).

Bachelor of Laws Honours (Exit Only).description: The Bachelor of Laws Honours (LLB(Hons)) is an exit award only. Students in Murdoch's Law degree include both school leavers and mature age students, and because the course is a professional preparation, a significant proportion of it is compulsory, giving all students a grounding in the legal system and the abilities required for professional legal practice, including practising those skills in simulated settings such as the Law School's Clinical Education Centre at Rockingham. Students build on this foundation through advanced units in areas such as corporate and commercial law, environmental law, family law, international law, alternative dispute resolution and human rights law.
Bachelor of Laws Honours (Exit Only).curriculum: Students apply for entry into Honours immediately before commencing their final 24 credit points of law study. The award of Honours is available on the basis of distinguished achievement across the Honours year. The required units are LLB580 (Honours Thesis in Law) and LLB582 (Legal Research Methods for Honours and Masters); the student's Honours program must also include any remaining required law units (such as LLB450 Civil Procedure, LLB452 Corporations Law and LLB468 Ethics and Professional Responsibility) or, if none remain, law specific elective units. Total: 96 credit points, 4 years full-time (AQF Level 8, Bachelor Honours Degree).
Bachelor of Laws Honours (Exit Only).admission_requirements: This is an exit award only, not a direct entry course. Students must already be enrolled in a Murdoch Bachelor of Laws Honours program (or one of its combined degrees) and apply for entry into the Honours year immediately prior to their final 24 credit points, with the award available on the basis of distinguished achievement across that Honours year.
Bachelor of Laws Honours (Exit Only).english_requirements: Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of 6.5, with no band below 6.5 (Murdoch Handbook entry for this award).

Diploma of Business.description: Murdoch's Diploma of Business gives students a broad introduction to business in a supportive, student centred learning environment, preparing them for further study or a professional business career. It covers business mathematics, marketing, management and governance, accounting, economics and business law, alongside career planning and academic and business communication skills. The knowledge and skills gained transfer directly into entry level business roles or further study, including as a pathway into Murdoch's undergraduate business degrees.
Diploma of Business.curriculum: 24 credit points across business mathematics, marketing, management and governance, accounting, economics and business law, plus academic and professional communication skills. Full-time duration: 1 year (AQF Level 5, Diploma).
Diploma of Business.admission_requirements: Successful completion of Year 12 with a minimum ATAR of 50, or a recognised Foundation Program, or an AQF Certificate IV.
Diploma of Business.english_requirements: Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of 5.5, with no band below 5.0.

Diploma of Information Technology.description: Murdoch's Diploma of Information Technology gives students a broad introduction to IT in a supportive, student centred learning environment, preparing them for further study or entry level IT employment. It covers foundations of computer systems, information systems, discrete mathematics, programming, and server environments and architecture, alongside career planning and academic and business communication skills, and can lead into Murdoch's undergraduate IT degrees.
Diploma of Information Technology.curriculum: 24 credit points across foundations of computer systems, information systems, discrete mathematics, programming, and server environments and architecture. Full-time duration: 2 trimesters, around 1 year (AQF Level 5, Diploma).
Diploma of Information Technology.admission_requirements: Successful completion of Year 12 with a minimum ATAR of 50, or a recognised Foundation Program, or an AQF Certificate IV.
Diploma of Information Technology.english_requirements: Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of 5.5, with no band below 5.0.

Graduate Certificate in Research Applica.description: The Graduate Certificate in Research Application is a 12 credit point research degree designed to be completed within 1 trimester, for students who want additional or specialised research training. It is designed for graduates who want to progress to research studies, industry professionals extending their research expertise, and other professionals undertaking research relevant to their field. Candidature is offered across all of Murdoch's Colleges, Institutes and Centres, with interdisciplinary research encouraged.
Graduate Certificate in Research Applica.curriculum: 12 credit points of graduate research training coursework covering research design and methodology, delivered under Murdoch's Higher Degree by Research training framework; there is no thesis component at this level (a research thesis is only required at Research Masters or PhD level).
Graduate Certificate in Research Applica.admission_requirements: A Bachelor Degree (AQF Level 7), or evidence to the satisfaction of the Dean of Graduate Research of scholarly or professional attainments equivalent to AQF Level 7, plus Murdoch's standard English requirement for entry into a Higher Degree by Research program.
Graduate Certificate in Research Applica.english_requirements: Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of 6.5, with no band below 6.0.

Graduate Certificate in Systems Medicine.description: This 6 month Graduate Certificate trains students in omics science technologies and their application in healthcare, giving graduates from any AQF Level 7 discipline theoretical knowledge and practical experience from researchers working at the forefront of systems medicine, and developing the multidisciplinary expertise sought by employers in academia, industry and healthcare.
Graduate Certificate in Systems Medicine.curriculum: 12 credit points of coursework in omics science and systems medicine, completed over 6 months full-time (AQF Level 8, Graduate Certificate).
Graduate Certificate in Systems Medicine.admission_requirements: A recognised Bachelor Degree (AQF Level 7) with a GPA of 2.5 or higher, including studies in either biochemistry or chemistry and either mathematics or statistics; applicants who can show equivalent knowledge through vocational training or professional experience will also be considered.
Graduate Certificate in Systems Medicine.english_requirements: Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of 6.5, with no band below 6.0.

Graduate Diploma in Business Administrat.description: The Graduate Diploma in Business Administration is an alternative exit award only, for students enrolled in Murdoch's Master of Business Administration (MBA) or MBA (Global) who complete 24 of the program's 36 credit points but do not wish to complete the full Master's. The MBA develops specialist knowledge in creating and managing global businesses, leadership, strategy, accounting, organisational behaviour, economics and finance, marketing, and entrepreneurship and innovation.
Graduate Diploma in Business Administrat.curriculum: 24 of the MBA / MBA (Global)'s 36 credit points, covering leadership, strategy, accounting, organisational behaviour, economics and finance, marketing, and entrepreneurship and innovation; completed within the MBA program rather than as a standalone enrolment. Full-time duration: 1 year (AQF Level 8, Graduate Diploma).
Graduate Diploma in Business Administrat.admission_requirements: This is an exit award only, available to students already enrolled in Murdoch's Master of Business Administration or MBA (Global), whose own entry requirement is a recognised Bachelor's degree or higher plus 2 years of work experience, or completion of the Graduate Certificate in Business Administration (or equivalent), or equivalent professional experience approved by the Academic Chair.
Graduate Diploma in Business Administrat.english_requirements: Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of 6.0, with no band below 6.0.

Graduate Diploma in Food Security.description: The Graduate Diploma in Food Security is an early exit award within Murdoch's Master of Food Security (M1311), for students who complete 24 of the program's 48 credit points. The Master's provides an in-depth appreciation of food security in a global context, examining sustainable food production, the principles and global challenges of food security, biosecurity of the food supply chain, and sustainable development practices, with electives spanning climate change, global governance, policy and innovation.
Graduate Diploma in Food Security.curriculum: 24 of the Master of Food Security's 48 credit points, covering core units on food security principles and global challenges, biosecurity of the food supply chain, and sustainable development practices, plus electives such as climate change, global governance, policy and innovation; completed as an early exit within the Master's program. Full-time duration: 1 year (AQF Level 8, Graduate Diploma).
Graduate Diploma in Food Security.admission_requirements: This is an early exit award within Murdoch's Master of Food Security, whose own entry requirement is completion of an AQF Level 7 qualification in the plant, food, ecological, environmental or animal sciences, or an equivalent field approved by the Academic Chair.
Graduate Diploma in Food Security.english_requirements: Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of 6.5, with no band below 6.0.

Graduate Diploma in Systems Medicine.description: The Graduate Diploma in Systems Medicine is a 12 month, 24 credit point program in omics science technologies and their application in healthcare. Alongside the 12 credit point Graduate Certificate in Systems Medicine, it is one of the two qualifications Murdoch's Handbook names as an accepted entry pathway into the Master of Systems Medicine (Research) for students who complete either award with a course average of 65% or higher. It is CRICOS registered (course code 103898G, confirmed current via the government CRICOS course search) under Field of Education 0109 Biological Sciences, but unlike the Graduate Certificate and the Master's it does not currently have its own listing in Murdoch's Handbook search or a standalone marketing page.
Graduate Diploma in Systems Medicine.curriculum: 24 credit points of coursework in omics science technologies, doubling the coursework load of the 12 credit point Graduate Certificate in Systems Medicine; Murdoch does not publish an itemised unit list for this standalone award.
Graduate Diploma in Systems Medicine.admission_requirements: Murdoch's Handbook does not publish a separate entry requirement for this specific award; the closely related Graduate Certificate in Systems Medicine (the shorter, 12 credit point version of the same coursework) requires a recognised Bachelor Degree (AQF Level 7) with a GPA of 2.5 or higher, including studies in either biochemistry or chemistry and either mathematics or statistics.
Graduate Diploma in Systems Medicine.english_requirements: Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of 6.5, with no band below 6.0 (the figure published for the Graduate Certificate in Systems Medicine and the Master of Systems Medicine (Research), the two directly documented awards in the same program family).

Graduate Diploma in Veterinary Clinical.description: The Graduate Diploma in Veterinary Clinical Studies is an early exit point for the Master of Veterinary Clinical Studies (M1223). Students must be accepted into the Master's and complete 24 credit points to exit with the Graduate Diploma. The Master's degree gives veterinarians engaged in advanced clinical training the opportunity to undertake intense clinical training through supervised management of clinical cases in a selected field of veterinary clinical science, alongside attendance and participation in clinical rounds, seminars, journal club and necropsy presentations, and completion of papers for publication in peer reviewed journals. The Graduate Diploma provides an early exit point for veterinarians only interested in 12 months of training, or for those unable to continue in the full length program.
Graduate Diploma in Veterinary Clinical.curriculum: 24 credit points completed as an early exit point within the Master of Veterinary Clinical Studies (M1223), covering supervised management of clinical cases in a selected field of veterinary clinical science, together with attendance and participation in clinical rounds, seminars, journal club and necropsy presentations; for veterinarians completing only the first 12 months of the full length program. Full-time duration: 1 year (AQF Level 8, Graduate Diploma).
Graduate Diploma in Veterinary Clinical.admission_requirements: Current registration as a Veterinary Surgeon in Australia, or recognised qualifications that would permit such registration, plus acceptance into a Residency Training Program in Murdoch's College of Veterinary Medicine, plus approval of the Academic Chair.
Graduate Diploma in Veterinary Clinical.english_requirements: Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of 7.0, with no band below 7.0.

Master of Systems Medicine (Research).description: Murdoch's Master of Systems Medicine (Research) is a 2 year research degree that trains students in omics science technologies and their application in healthcare. Students gain theoretical knowledge and practical experience from researchers working at the forefront of systems medicine, then apply it to a real world healthcare related research project, developing the multidisciplinary expertise sought by employers in academia, industry and healthcare.
Master of Systems Medicine (Research).curriculum: 12 credit points of taught coursework, 12 credit points of research preparation, and a 24 credit point research thesis; total 48 credit points over 2 years full-time (AQF Level 9, Masters Degree (Research)).
Master of Systems Medicine (Research).admission_requirements: A recognised Bachelor Degree (AQF Level 7) with a GPA of 3.0 or higher, including studies in either biochemistry or chemistry and either mathematics or statistics, or completion of the Graduate Certificate in Systems Medicine or Graduate Diploma in Systems Medicine with a course average of 65% or higher; exceptional applicants with a lower GPA who have relevant research or professional experience may also be considered.
Master of Systems Medicine (Research).english_requirements: Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of 6.5, with no band below 6.0.

Research Masters with Training.description: Murdoch's Research Masters with Training (RMT) is offered across all disciplines, with interdisciplinary research encouraged as well as work in the basic disciplines. It combines required research training coursework with a supervised research project ending in a thesis, and is an 18 month full-time (or 3 year part-time) degree designed for industry professionals extending their research expertise, professionals wanting to undertake research relevant to their field, and those hoping to proceed to a higher research degree but lacking the conventional academic background. On completion, graduates are assessed and may be considered eligible for PhD candidature, so it is commonly used as a bridge into a doctorate as well as a standalone qualification.
Research Masters with Training.curriculum: 12 credit points of graduate research training coursework, followed by a 24 credit point research thesis; total 36 credit points over 18 months full-time (or 3 years part-time).
Research Masters with Training.admission_requirements: A Bachelor Degree in the same or a cognate discipline (AQF Level 7); or a Bachelor Degree in a different discipline plus either a related graduate qualification of at least one year of full-time study (AQF Level 8) or at least two years of relevant full-time professional experience approved by the Dean of Graduate Research; or evidence to the satisfaction of the Dean of Graduate Research of significant scholarly or professional attainments equivalent to AQF Level 8.
Research Masters with Training.english_requirements: Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of 6.5, with no band below 6.0, or equivalent (TOEFL iBT 79, PTE Academic 58).
